evals.prompt: Scaffold a new Vue 3 H5 mobile-web project with Vant 4, Pinia, and i18n.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the vue3-h5-template starter-template source, picks the right branch (master / i18n / js-version), and surfaces the feature list.
expectations: Recommends vue3-h5-template with the matching branch

evals.prompt: I want a real-world H5 e-commerce reference to learn from. Any open-source Vue 3 mall?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the newbee-mall-vue3-app reference-project source, surfaces the tech stack (Vue 3 + Vant 4 + Pinia + better-scroll) and page modules.
expectations: Surfaces the page modules (login / home / cart / order / address)

evals.prompt: How do I handle vw / rem adaptation for a Vue 3 H5 page so it scales across phone widths?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the mobile-web-best-practice source, picks the Style Adaptation topic, and cites with kind=best-practices.
expectations: Routes to mobile-web-best-practice Style Adaptation topic

evals.prompt: My 1px border looks thick on retina phones. What's the H5 pattern for true 1px?
evals.expected_output: Points at the 1px border topic in mobile-web-best-practice, also notes if the starter template demonstrates the pattern.
expectations: Routes to mobile-web-best-practice for the 1px border topic
Surfaces the starter template if it demonstrates the pattern

evals.prompt: How do I safely call native APIs from a WebView via JSBridge?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the JSBridge / native API guard topic in mobile-web-best-practice and cites the source.

evals.prompt: I need a layered architecture for my H5 app — what's the recommended structure?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the Layered Architecture topic in mobile-web-best-practice and cites the source.
expectations: Routes to mobile-web-best-practice Layered Architecture topic

evals.prompt: How should I monitor JS errors and capture crashes on mobile H5?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the Error Monitoring topic in mobile-web-best-practice (mentions Sentry) and cites the source.
expectations: Routes to mobile-web-best-practice Error Monitoring topic

evals.prompt: I want to cache repeated HTTP requests on the H5 to avoid redundant network calls. What's the pattern?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the Request Cache topic in mobile-web-best-practice and cites the source.
expectations: Routes to mobile-web-best-practice Request Cache topic

evals.prompt: Which H5 debug console should I embed — vConsole or eruda?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the Debug Console topic in mobile-web-best-practice and notes the starter template ships eruda.
expectations: Routes to mobile-web-best-practice Debug Console topic
Notes the starter template's eruda integration

evals.prompt: I want my H5 to support safe-area insets for notched iPhones.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the Style Adaptation topic in mobile-web-best-practice for safe-area-inset patterns and cites the source.
expectations: Routes to mobile-web-best-practice Style Adaptation topic
